name: agent-hub-platform
description: Multi-cloud AI Agent Platform — build, deploy & manage agents with MCP, Vector DB, Multi-Agent workflows, Learning Analytics, Enterprise integrations and more

scripts.start:backend:local: cd agent-hub-backend && cross-env PORT=3002 npm run dev
scripts.start:backend:prod: cd agent-hub-backend && npm run build:prod && npm run start:prod
scripts.start:backend:prod:bedrock: cd agent-hub-backend && cross-env NODE_ENV=production BEDROCK_ENABLED=true npm run start:prod
scripts.start:ui:local: cd agent-hub-ui && cross-env PORT=3001 npm start
scripts.start:ui:prod: cd agent-hub-ui && npm run build && serve -s build -l 80
scripts.setup:local: npm run setup:backend && npm run setup:ui && npm run setup:local:env
scripts.test:local: npm run test:backend && npm run test:ui
scripts.build:all: npm run build:backend && npm run build:ui
scripts.clean: npm run clean:backend && npm run clean:ui && npm run clean:data

author: AgentHub Team
